parameters.query:
SELECT article_url, full_content, ai_summary, ai_bullets, ai_tags,
  affected_currency, market_sentiment, market_impact_note
FROM articles
WHERE created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '14 days'

INSERT INTO articles (title, source, image_url, summary, article_url, read_time_minutes, category, published_at, full_content, ai_summary, ai_bullets, ai_tags, affected_currency, market_sentiment, market_impact_note)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8::timestamptz, $9, $10, $11::jsonb, $12::jsonb, $13, $14, $15)
ON CONFLICT (article_url) DO UPDATE SET
  title = EXCLUDED.title,
  image_url = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.image_url, articles.image_url),
  summary = EXCLUDED.summary,
  read_time_minutes = EXCLUDED.read_time_minutes,
  category = EXCLUDED.category,
  full_content = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.full_content, articles.full_content),
  ai_summary = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.ai_summary, articles.ai_summary),
  ai_bullets = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.ai_bullets, articles.ai_bullets),
  ai_tags = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.ai_tags, articles.ai_tags),
  affected_currency = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.affected_currency, articles.affected_currency),
  market_sentiment = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.market_sentiment, articles.market_sentiment),
  market_impact_note = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.market_impact_note, articles.market_impact_note)

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [$json.title, $json.source, $json.image_url, $json.summary, $json.article_url, $json.read_time_minutes, $json.category, $json.published_at, $json.full_content, $json.ai_summary, $json.ai_bullets ? JSON.stringify($json.ai_bullets) : null, $json.ai_tags ? JSON.stringify($json.ai_tags) : null, $json.affected_currency || null, $json.market_sentiment || null, $json.market_impact_note || null] }}

parameters.query:
-- Curs curent + punct la minut în istoric + puncte zilnice (is_daily) + curățare:
-- punctele la minut se păstrează 30 de zile, cele zilnice 5 ani (graficele 1 A / Max).
WITH up AS (
  INSERT INTO market_rates (pair, rate, change_percent, source, updated_at)
  VALUES ($1, $2::numeric, $3::numeric, $4, NOW())
  ON CONFLICT (pair) DO UPDATE SET
    rate = EXCLUDED.rate,
    change_percent = EXCLUDED.change_percent,
    source = EXCLUDED.source,
    updated_at = NOW()
  RETURNING pair, rate
), snap AS (
  INSERT INTO market_rate_history (pair, rate, recorded_at)
  SELECT pair, rate, date_trunc('minute', NOW()) FROM up
  ON CONFLICT (pair, recorded_at) DO NOTHING
), backfill AS (
  INSERT INTO market_rate_history (pair, rate, recorded_at, is_daily)
  SELECT $1, (h->>'rate')::numeric, (h->>'recorded_at')::timestamptz, TRUE
  FROM jsonb_array_elements($5::jsonb) AS h
  WHERE (h->>'recorded_at')::timestamptz > NOW() - INTERVAL '5 years'
  ON CONFLICT (pair, recorded_at) DO UPDATE SET rate = EXCLUDED.rate, is_daily = TRUE
), prune AS (
  DELETE FROM market_rate_history
  WHERE (NOT is_daily AND recorded_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days')
     OR (is_daily AND recorded_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '5 years')
)
SELECT pair FROM up;
